mapper.select: SELECT IS_LAY FROM FIN_PRODUCT_ADD WHERE FINPROD_ID = '${finProdId}'

SELECT fin.FINPROD_MARKET_ID AS prodId, val.VALUATION AS netValue, to_char(val.PUBLISH_DATE,'yyyyMMdd') AS netValueDate, to_char(val.VAL_DATE,'yyyyMMdd') AS effectDate, val.TOTAL_VALUE AS totalNetValue, val.YEAR_YIELD AS yearYield, val.DAY7_YEAR_YIELD AS sevenDaysYield, pafin.DEAL_MODE AS productType, CASE WHEN pafin.DEAL_MODE = '08' THEN val.VALUATION ELSE null END AS unitIncome, NULL AS yieldStTime, NULL AS yieldEdTime, finadd.INVEST_NATURE AS incomeType FROM FIN_PRODUCT fin, FIN_PRODUCT_ADD finadd, PA_FIN_PRODUCT pafin, FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION val WHERE fin.FINPROD_ID = finadd.FINPROD_ID(+) AND fin.FINPROD_ID = pafin.FINPROD_ID(+) AND fin.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = val.finprod_id AND fin.FINPROD_TYPE2 = val.FINPROD_TYPE2 AND fin.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{prodType, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND fin.FINPROD_ID = #{finProdId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND to_char(val.VAL_DATE,'yyyyMMdd') = #{cdate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT fin.FINPROD_MARKET_ID AS prodId, pafin.DEAL_MODE AS productType, NULL AS yieldStTime, NULL AS yieldEdTime, finadd.INVEST_NATURE AS incomeType FROM FIN_PRODUCT fin, FIN_PRODUCT_ADD finadd, PA_FIN_PRODUCT pafin WHERE fin.FINPROD_ID = finadd.FINPROD_ID(+) AND fin.FINPROD_ID = pafin.FINPROD_ID(+) AND fin.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{prodType, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND fin.FINPROD_ID = #{finProdId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT lay.TERM_MIN || ',' || lay.TERM_MAX AS holdDaysInterval, lay.AMT_MIN || ',' || lay.AMT_MAX AS buyAmtInterval, lay.CUSTOM_LEVEL || ',' || lay.CUSTOM_LEVEL AS clientLvlInterval, lay.YIELD AS levelYield, CASE WHEN calc.BASIS = 'A/360' THEN '360' ELSE '365' END AS yearInterestDay FROM FIN_PRODUCT fin, PRD_LAYER_PARAM lay, FIN_CASH_INFO info, FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE calc WHERE fin.FINPROD_ID = lay.FINPROD_ID(+) AND fin.FINPROD_ID = info.FINPROD_ID(+) AND fin.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{prodType, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND fin.P_FINPROD_ID = #{finProdId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND info.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashType, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND info.CASH_ID = calc.CASH_ID AND to_char(calc.EFF_DATE, 'yyyyMMdd') = #{cdate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT '1,9999' AS holdDaysInterval, '1,999999999' AS buyAmtInterval, '0,9' AS clientLvlInterval, calc.YIELD AS levelYield, CASE WHEN calc.BASIS = 'A/360' THEN '360' ELSE '365' END AS yearInterestDay FROM FIN_PRODUCT fin, FIN_CASH_INFO info, FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE calc WHERE fin.FINPROD_ID = info.FINPROD_ID(+) AND fin.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{prodType, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND fin.FINPROD_ID = #{finProdId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND info.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashType, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND info.CASH_ID = calc.CASH_ID AND to_char(calc.EFF_DATE, 'yyyyMMdd') = #{cdate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
